brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir's statements about Palestinians in Gaza resemble rhetoric from Nazi official Heinrich Himmler, U2 frontman Bono said, according to Middle East Eye. The comparison comes as Ben-Gvir faces repeated international criticism over his public statements regarding the conflict.

Ben-Gvir, a far-right politician, has made inflammatory remarks about Palestinians and has drawn condemnation from international figures and human rights organizations over his positions on Gaza and Palestinian rights.
dek: Bono compares Ben-Gvir’s Gaza rhetoric to Nazi official Heinrich Himmler Bono has compared Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir’s statements about Palestinians in Gaza to those of Nazi official Heinrich Himmler.
title: Bono compares Ben-Gvir's Gaza rhetoric to Nazi propaganda
